The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Honduras has instructed me to express our
views on the contents of the note dated 6 April 1983 addressed to you by the
Permanent Representative of France to the United Nations (S/15689).

III. The Permanent Representative of Honduras to the United Nations,
participating in the debate at the invitation of the President of the Security
Council, said in his statement that his country respected international commitments
and that both Nicaragua and Honduras had a regional and continental commitment, as
members of the Organization of American States, whose Charter clearly stated that
disputes between member countries should be submitted to the procedures provided
for in that Charter before they could be taken to the United Nations Security
Council (S/PV.2425, pp. 81-82).

For all the reasons stated above, the Government of Honduras is of the view
that, in order that the eagerly awaited dialogue may become a reality at the
earliest possible moment, it will be appropriate first to exhaust the regional
effort within the context of the inter-American system, bearing in mind that
results of the greatest importance for peace and stability in Central America are
now being looked forward to.
I should be grateful if you could have this letter circulated as a Security
Council document.
(Signed) Enrique ORTEZ COLINDRES
Ambassador, Permanent Representative of Honduras
to the United Nations

البلدان الا مريكية بأن بيقى على علم بما يجرى في عطية القاوضات وبأن يتتبع سيرها عن كشب
